LESSON: BUSINESS TRANSACTIONS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: BUSINESS STUDIES
Strand: Financial Records in Business
Topic 4.1: Business Transactions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Business Transactions, part of Financial Records in Business in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 BUSINESS STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is it necessary to record business transactions?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Business Transactions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Responsibility: learner shows accountability when filling in a questionnaire on the methods of payment used in the

school.

● Love: learner respects others when discussing and presenting on the meaning and types of business transactions.

● Respect: learner shows regard for the contributions of every member of the team when discussing and presenting

on the meaning and types of business transactions.

● Social justice: learner exercises equity as they accord privileges without favour when role playing different

methods used in making payments for goods and services.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Financial Literacy: Financial skills of the learner are enhanced when discussing methods of payment.

● Social Cohesion: Learners’ unity is enhanced when role playing different methods used in making payments for

goods and services.

● Business Studies curriculum design

● Business Studies handbook

● Digital device with assistive technology.

● Volunteer resource person

● Approved textbooks and reference materials

● Photographs and pictures

● Charts, tactile charts

● Samples of financial records

● Local market
